Written by hand.
A module whose generated file imports a package nothing in the fetched tree
imports. The zip carries the directive and the generator, and not the file
the generator writes.

-- .mod --
module example.com/generatedimport

//go:gendep

go 1.16
-- .info --
{"Version": "v1.0.0"}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/generatedimport

//go:gendep

go 1.16
-- gen/main.go --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "file to write")
	flag.Parse()
	body := "package lang\n\nimport \"example.com/generatedimport/word\"\n\nfunc Name() string { return word.Generated }\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte(body), 0o666); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- lang/lang.go --
//go:generate go run example.com/generatedimport/gen -out lang.gen.go

// Package lang declares nothing itself: Name is the generator's to write.
package lang
-- word/word.go --
// Package word is imported by the generated file alone.
package word

const Generated = "generated"
